definitions.gloss: intermediary; go-between; the person or thing that connects; bridging role
definitions.explanation: Someone — or occasionally something — that serves to connect, link, or bridge two sides. Often used for a person who mediates between two parties, or a figure who links an older and newer generation, or someone filling a temporary connecting role.

examples.japanese: つなぎ{役|やく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{社長|しゃちょう}→社長：01428_shachou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧つなぎ{役|やく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たしている→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: She serves as the go-between linking the president and the employees.

examples.japanese: ⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{古参|こさん}→古参：06288_kosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧つなぎ{役|やく}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧、⟦{中堅|ちゅうけん}→中堅：06876_chuuken⟧⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{役割|やくわり}→役割：03638_yakuwari⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: Mid-career employees play a major role as the bridge between young and veteran staff.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧、⟦コーチ→コーチ：03844_koochi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つなぎ{役|やく}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{指揮|しき}→指揮：11102_shiki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧とることになった。
examples.english: Until a new manager is chosen, the coach will take the helm in a bridging role.

notes:
Composed of つなぎ (the nominal form of ⟦{繋|つな}ぐ→繋ぐ：01962_tsunagu⟧ "to connect") and ⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧ (role, part). Describes a person or position that connects two sides, parties, generations, or eras. Often used in workplace, political, and sports contexts.

The word has two closely related flavors:
1. A mediator or go-between who passes information or smooths relations between two parties
2. A transitional figure who fills a gap between something ending and something beginning (e.g., an acting leader)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- つなぎ{役|やく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たす→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧: to fulfill a bridging role
- つなぎ{役|やく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to become an intermediary
- つなぎ{役|やく}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{働|はたら}く→働く：00503_hataraku⟧: to work as a go-between
- ⟦{世代|せだい}→世代：05102_sedai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧つなぎ{役|やく}: a bridge between generations

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {仲介役|ちゅうかいやく}: mediating role, agent — more formal, often used in business and legal contexts
- ⟦{調整役|ちょうせいやく}→調整役：26233_chouseiyaku⟧: coordinating role — emphasizes harmonizing interests rather than simply connecting them
- ⟦{橋渡|はしわた}し→橋渡し：09606_hashiwatashi⟧: bridge-building, mediation — a metaphor for the same role
- ⟦{中継|ちゅうけい}→中継：11306_chuukei⟧⟦{役|やく}→役：12557_yaku⟧: relay role — emphasizes passing something along, as in broadcasting or baseball relays
